title: Compactness for sets of locally uniformly bounded perimeter (Simon Ch. 2, 2.6)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and let F_k ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} (k ∈ ℕ) be Borel sets such that for every R > 0 there is C_R ∈ ℝ with ∫_{F_k} div g dL^{m+1} ≤ C_R for all sufficiently large k and every C¹ compactly supported g : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} with tsupport g ⊆ B_R(0) and |g| ≤ 1. Then there are a strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ and a Borel set F₀ ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} with L^{m+1}((F_{ψ(j)} Δ F₀) ∩ B_R(0)) → 0 as j → ∞ for every R ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → Set (Euclid (m + 1))), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (Fs k)) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in Fs k, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) ≤ C) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (F₀ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), StrictMono ψ ∧ MeasurableSet F₀ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => volume (symmDiff (Fs (ψ j)) F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R)) atTop (𝓝 0)
